notes: The listener notices a role bucket deleted out of band only at its 30 s self-health probe; until then it keeps answering from the deleted bucket's view (the holder kept its role for ~29 s in my runs). That latency is the existing self-health rebuild, shared by every watched cache, and not this change; the answer after detection is correct.
